page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs, 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB of RAM per vCPU, and 944 GB of attached local SSD storage. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with the instance.

The primary feature of this instance is its hardware acceleration, featuring 2 NVIDIA P100 GPUs supplying a combined 32 GB of VRAM. This dual-GPU configuration enables offloading of parallel computational tasks directly to hardware accelerators. Benchmark evaluation data for CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and LLM execution is unavailable for this specific hardware configuration.

The allocation of 7.5 GB RAM per vCPU along with dual dedicated GPUs offers resource density for accelerated computing tasks without requiring large CPU core counts. Hardware tradeoffs include the use of Pascal-generation NVIDIA P100 GPUs, which do not feature newer instructions like Tensor Cores. The instance targets workloads such as deep learning inference, scientific computing, CUDA-accelerated mathematical modeling, and video rendering pipelines requiring dedicated VRAM and local SSD storage.
